decisions.reason: The semi-hard cheese wheel is a basic item close to the core organic dairy offer, but its absence from the website in 2020 and 2021 raises some withdrawal risk.
The spicy cheese line may be trimmed as the flagship onion-and-pepper cheese was, but the line as a whole can likely still be kept by cutting individual variants.
The mild creamy soft cheese has the broadest appeal of the 2018 cheese range, though it was no longer visible on the website after 2019.
The washed-rind soft cheese is the most niche item, faces the highest delisting risk with retailers, and was no longer visible, so its resources are better moved to the core dairy business.
